title: Namaqualand Boulder 03
author: Jenelle van Heerden, Dario Barresi
processing: Imported the 2k glTF (md5 verified) in Blender 5.0 (--factory-startup --disable-autoexec). Kept the variants listed, applied transforms, origin at bottom centre, variants laid out in a row along X. Collapse decimation (Blender 5.0 Decimate, no bake: the original 2k normal map is reused); budget 20000 tris per variant. Result (boulder_03_LOD0: 64826->19999 tris). Exported single .glb, embedded 2k textures, no Draco. doubleSided restored from the source glTF; alphaMode set to MASK 0.5 only where the base-colour image has an alpha channel, otherwise opaque (Poly Haven leaf shapes are real geometry and their diffuse maps carry no alpha). Variants of the source model not listed were dropped; per-variant tri counts: [19999].
